ev.q: Five of nine children with known exposure to a person with mpox were reported to have had close physical contact
Seven of the children aged 0–4 years, and two of those aged 5–12 years had known exposure to a person with mpox
notably, four of five children aged 0–4 years had skin-to-skin contact
CDC provided a questionnaire to state and local health departments for collection of the child’s history of exposure
